4	
5	## 分类总览

11	| Dual-critic / Wide-critic 跨环境失败 | 5 | 14.3% | exp_034 (Cheetah dual-critic), exp_038 (Walker s2 non-CIVO collapse) |
12	| dt>1 本身退化 | 5 | 14.3% | exp_007 (fixed dt=4), exp_008f_s4 (no-dt-emb control) |
13	| CIVO 复现/表征（诊断性 negative） | 4 | 11.4% | exp_009e (CIVO collapse confirmed), exp_008e_v3_s3 (stochastic collapse) |
14	| Event-gate 机制失败 | 3 | 8.6% | exp_005 (v4 collapse @85K) |

16	| Frozen dt_emb 失败 | 1 | 2.9% | exp_015b (gradient starvation) |
17	
18	---
19	
20	## 详细分组
21	
22	### 类别 1：TCN 跨环境/剂量失败（10 个）
23	
24	TCN (Temporal Conditioning Noise) 在 Walker σ=0.2 上成功，但在其他环境或剂量下普遍失败。
25	
26	| exp_id | hypothesis | 环境 | 关键指标 | 简要结论 |
27	|--------|-----------|------|----------|----------|
28	| exp_027_tcn_walker_s0 | TCN σ=0.5 抑制 CIVO | Walker | eval peak 240@35K, oscillatory; eval_105K=95.5 | σ=0.5 过量：NVE 一度自修正但后续震荡性 CIVO，eval 大幅波动 |
29	| exp_027_tcn_walker_s1 | TCN σ=0.5 seed 1 复现 | Walker | eval peak 364.9@75K, last10 mean 233.1 | σ=0.5 跨 seed 不稳定，eval 振幅大（94.6–364.9），不可靠 |
30	| exp_029b_tcn_walker_s2_sigma02 | TCN σ=0.2 seed 2 方差表征 | Walker | eval peak 177.67@55K, CIVO onset @65K | s0=91% s1=45% s2=collapsed。σ=0.2 在 Walker 上高方差，2/4 seeds 仍崩溃 |
31	| exp_029c_tcn_walker_s0_sigma01 | σ=0.1 最低有效剂量测试 | Walker | eval peak 490.7@165K, final 328.3 | σ=0.1 未阻止 CIVO（NVE 曾 breach），但最终 eval 尚可；剂量不足以可靠抑制 |
32	| exp_029d_tcn_walker_s3_sigma02 | TCN σ=0.2 seed 3 统计补充 | Walker | eval peak 349.6@95K, CIVO onset @105K sudden blowup | 健康→突然崩溃（NVE 0.67@95K→3.0@105K），TCN σ=0.2 无法防止晚期 CIVO |
33	| exp_030a_tcn_cheetah_s0_sigma02 | TCN σ=0.2 跨环境验证 (Cheetah) | Cheetah | eval 299.5@35K→31.9@55K, NVE 1.903@55K | **σ=0.2 对 Cheetah 完全无效**，NVE 直接 breach 1.5×，eval 崩溃 |
34	| exp_030b_tcn_cheetah_s0_sigma05 | σ=0.5 Cheetah 环境适配剂量 | Cheetah | eval peak ~211.7@125K, NVE peak 10.67@55K | σ=0.5 未抑制 CIVO（NVE 10.67×），eval 长期低迷（68–211，baseline ~548） |
35	| exp_030c_tcn_cheetah_s0_sigma10 | σ=1.0 Cheetah 高剂量 | Cheetah | eval peak 371.7@35K, final 47.2 | σ=1.0 仍未抑制 Cheetah CIVO，eval 最终崩至 47.2（baseline ~548） |
36	| exp_031_tcn_pickcube_s0_sigma02 | TCN σ=0.2 跨域验证 (PickCube) | PickCube | eval peak 28.6@162K, NVE peak 3.71 | **PickCube 上 TCN 完全失败**，NVE 3.71×，gate entropy=0（gate 锁死） |
37	| exp_031b_tcn_pickcube_s0_sigma05 | σ=0.5 PickCube 剂量提升 | PickCube | eval peak 29.1, NVE peak 3.3@42K | σ=0.5 同样失败，NVE 仍达 3.3×，仅在 72.5K 后才被抑制 |
38	
39	**模式**：TCN 仅在 Walker σ=0.2 的部分 seeds 上有效（~50% success rate）。Cheetah（所有 σ 失败）和 PickCube（σ=0.2/0.5 失败）跨环境泛化彻底失败。表征级干预不足以应对高强度 CIVO。
40	
41	---
42	
43	### 类别 2：SGS 干预失败（5 个）
44	
45	Selective Gradient Stopping（梯度阻断）干预的全面否定——从 reward-head SGS 到 full-SGS 到 obs-decoder SGS，均无法可靠抑制 CIVO。
46	
47	| exp_id | hypothesis | 环境 | 关键指标 | 简要结论 |
48	|--------|-----------|------|----------|----------|
49	| exp_016e_sgs_walker_s1 | Reward-head SGS 阻断 CIVO 梯度通路 | Walker | NVE peak 10.42@95K, eval 31.7@95K | **关键发现**：reward loss 对 dt_emb.weight 梯度贡献=0，reward-head SGS 是 no-op。真正梯度来源是 decoder heads |
50	| exp_018v2_full_sgs_walker_s1 | Full-SGS 阻断所有 decoder→dt_emb 梯度 | Walker | eval peak 499.6@75K, NVE mean 1.23 (45K-105K), late collapse @112K | CIVO 减少 79% 但未消除；**晚期崩溃** @112K，eval 448→下降 |
51	| exp_018_full_sgs_s2 | Full-SGS seed 2 可靠性验证 | Walker | eval peak ~488@75K, final 40.8@105K, NVE 1.66@95K | **Seed 2 崩溃**，直接否定 018v2 的结论。Full-SGS 不可靠 |
52	| exp_021_full_sgs_cheetah_s1 | Full-SGS 跨环境验证 (Cheetah) | Cheetah | NVE peak 9.94@45K, eval final 221.5 (baseline 38.7%) | CIVO 类型=transient_self_correcting，NVE 仍达 9.94×。比 baseline 好 4.3× 但远未达标 |
53	| exp_025_obs_sgs_walker_s2 | Obs-decoder-only SGS | Walker | VE ratio 0.8-1.4, eval 66-90 (baseline ~930) | CIVO 部分抑制但 **eval 仅 baseline 7-10%**。obs-decoder SGS 摧毁性能同时未消除 CIVO |
54	
55	**模式**：梯度干预路线全面否定。Full-SGS 0/3 seeds 可靠，Obs-decoder SGS 0/6 有效。关键洞察：CIVO 的梯度来源不是 reward head 而是 decoder heads（016e 发现），但即使阻断全部 decoder 梯度也只是延迟而非消除 CIVO。

75	### 类别 4：dt>1 本身退化（5 个）
76	
77	temporal subsampling 自身导致的性能退化，与 CIVO 无关——即使没有 CIVO 现象，dt>1 也带来显著性能损失。
78	
79	| exp_id | hypothesis | 环境 | 关键指标 | 简要结论 |
80	|--------|-----------|------|----------|----------|
81	| exp_006_fixed_dt2 | Fixed dt=2 诊断（无 learned gate） | Walker | eval peak 485.3@35K, 65K 崩至 132.86 | dt=2 本身导致崩溃，非 gate 机制问题。VE ratio @65K=3.67 |
82	| exp_007_fixed_dt4 | Fixed dt=4 诊断 | Walker | eval peak 176.9@25K, 45K=144 (baseline 443) | dt=4 性能显著低于 baseline，进程 12.5min 后异常退出 |
83	| exp_008c_no_subsample_dt2_h8 | Subsample OFF + dt=2 imagination + H=8 | Walker | eval plateau ~241@55K-65K (baseline 616@65K) | 无 subsample 下 dt=2 imagination 也只达 baseline 39%，compounding error 是瓶颈 |
84	| exp_008f_s4 | No-dt-emb 控制组 seed 4 | Walker | eval 306.5@105K, peak 487.5@55K (baseline ~930) | 无 CIVO（NVE 0.58）但 eval 仅 baseline 33%。移除 dt_emb 避免 CIVO 但代价是巨大性能损失 |
85	| exp_009c_008f_walker_s2 | No-dt-emb 控制组 seed 2 | Walker | eval 148.34@105K, peak 359@75K | 比 seed 1（503@105K）更差，**无 dt_emb 方案 seed 方差极大且性能不可接受** |
86	
87	**模式**：dt>1 即使在最优配置下（fixed dt、no gate、no dt_emb）也带来 40-70% 的性能损失。这是 temporal subsampling 的根本局限——RSSM 对 dt>1 的多步预测质量不足，compounding error 随 horizon 累积。
88	
89	---
90	
91	### 类别 5：CIVO 复现/表征（诊断性 negative）（4 个）
92	
93	这些实验的 negative 结论是因为它们确认了 CIVO 现象的存在和严重性，是诊断性实验而非干预实验。
94	
95	| exp_id | hypothesis | 环境 | 关键指标 | 简要结论 |
96	|--------|-----------|------|----------|----------|
97	| exp_009e_008d_walker_s1 | 008d CIVO 复现（seed 1 延长至 105K） | Walker | NVE 4.13@55K, eval 131.08@105K | CIVO collapse 确认：eval 从正常水平崩至 131，actor_loss 翻正@85K |
98	| exp_009b_008d_walker_s2 | 008d CIVO 复现（seed 2） | Walker | NVE peak 1.62@45K (transient), eval 268 | CIVO 未复现（self-corrected），但 eval 仍远低于 baseline。NVE>1.5× threshold 可靠但 collapse 是随机的 |
99	| exp_008e_v3_s3 | dt=1/H=15 多 seed 验证 | Walker | NVE 4.02@105K, eval 92.7, collapse @85K-95K | dt=1 配置仍出现 CIVO collapse（1/3 seeds），证明 CIVO 是随机性的 |
100	| exp_008e_v3_walker_s2 | dt=1/H=15 seed 2 crown jewel 验证 | Walker | eval peak 715@85K→137@105K, NVE 3.78× | C6 配置 collapse：即使 gate 锁定 dt=1，1/3 seeds 仍崩溃。Collapse 是随机的 |
101	
102	**模式**：CIVO 是随机性事件（30-50% 发生率），即使在最保守配置（dt=1）下仍可发生。NVE>1.5× 是可靠的早期预警指标，但 collapse 发生与否有随机性。
103	
104	---
105	
106	### 类别 6：Event-gate 机制失败（3 个）
107	
108	项目最初提出的 event-gated adaptive horizon 核心机制的早期失败。
109	
110	| exp_id | hypothesis | 环境 | 关键指标 | 简要结论 |
111	|--------|-----------|------|----------|----------|
112	| exp_003_event_gated_v2 | Event-gated v2 | Walker | eval 92.3-118.7@105K-115K, gate entropy ratio 0.796 | C1 return FAIL (baseline 0.13×)，gate 分布有多样性但 return 极低 |
113	| exp_004_event_gated_v3 | 修复 imagination dt 约束后的 v3 | Walker | — | 修复 logits masking 后仍失败 |
114	| exp_005_event_gated_v4 | Learned gate 改善 sample efficiency | Walker | eval peak 541.18@55K→98.84@145K (baseline ~950) | 早期有希望（55K 达 541）但后期崩溃至 98.84。Gate mean 收敛到 ~2.0，学习不稳定 |
115	
116	**模式**：Learned gate 机制从 v2 到 v4 持续失败。核心问题：gate 的 dt>1 选择引入 CIVO 现象，而 gate 本身无法学会规避这一问题。这一失败直接催生了 CIVO 研究方向的转向。
117	
118	---
119	
120	### 类别 7：RAVE 干预失败（2 个）
121	
122	Reality-Anchored Value Estimation（直接 clip value ratio）的失败。
123	
124	| exp_id | hypothesis | 环境 | 关键指标 | 简要结论 |
125	|--------|-----------|------|----------|----------|
126	| exp_028_rave_walker_s0 | RAVE ceiling=2.0 cap imagination value | Walker | eval peak 204.6, 105K=29, VE ratio 3.183@105K | **RAVE 完全失败**：ceiling=2.0 未阻止 VE ratio 上升至 3.183，eval 崩至 29 |
127	| exp_028_rave_walker_s0_ceil15 | RAVE ceiling=1.5 更激进 cap | Walker | eval peak 180.1@35K, 135K=39.1 | Tighter ceiling 同样失败，eval 持续下降至 39.1。Value capping 无法解决根因 |
128	
129	**模式**：直接 clip value ratio 不仅未能抑制 CIVO，反而可能干扰正常的 value 学习。CIVO 的根因不在 value 数值大小，而在 value 的结构性偏差。
130	
131	---
132	
133	### 类别 8：Frozen dt_emb 失败（1 个）
134	
135	冻结 dt_emb 权重的因果诊断实验。
136	
137	| exp_id | hypothesis | 环境 | 关键指标 | 简要结论 |
138	|--------|-----------|------|----------|----------|
139	| exp_015b_frozen_dt_emb | Frozen dt_emb 隔离训练 vs 存在的因果效应 | Walker | eval 204.2@105K, peak 211.2@65K (baseline ~930) | **Gradient starvation**：冻结 dt_emb 导致 actor_loss 接近 0（0.000179@105K），entropy 异常低（-4.855）。证明 dt_emb 训练对正常学习是必要的 |
140	
141	**模式**：不能通过冻结 dt_emb 来避免 CIVO——dt_emb 的梯度流对整体学习至关重要，阻断它会导致 gradient starvation。
142	
143	---
144	
145	## 跨类别观察
146	
147	### 1. 干预层级递进失败链
148	项目经历了清晰的干预层级递进：**梯度级（SGS）→ 表征级（TCN）→ 值函数级（RAVE）→ 架构级（dual-critic）**。每一级都因不同原因失败，揭示 CIVO 是一个多层面问题：
149	- 梯度阻断（SGS）：延迟但不消除 CIVO
150	- 噪声注入（TCN）：环境敏感、剂量窗口极窄
151	- 值裁剪（RAVE）：未触及根因
152	- 架构冗余（dual-critic）：Cheetah 上双 critic 无差异化，Walker 上暴露 non-CIVO collapse
153	
154	### 2. 环境依赖性是系统性障碍
155	几乎所有干预方法都表现出强烈的环境依赖性。在 Walker 上部分有效的方法迁移到 Cheetah（更强 CIVO）或 PickCube（不同动力学）后失败。这表明 CIVO 的严重程度和机制可能因环境而异。
156	
157	### 3. CIVO 的随机性本质
158	即使在相同配置下，CIVO collapse 也只在 30-50% 的 seeds 上发生（exp_008e_v3 系列：3 seeds 中 1 个 collapse；exp_029 系列：4 seeds 中 2 个 collapse）。这意味着单 seed 实验无法可靠判断干预是否有效。
159	
160	### 4. 非 CIVO 退化机制
161	exp_038 揭示了一个重要盲点：成功抑制 CIVO（NVE≤0.3）后仍可能出现 eval collapse。这说明 dt>1 imagination 还存在 CIVO 以外的退化机制，可能与 compounding error 或 policy exploration 相关。
162	
163	### 5. dt>1 的根本性限制
164	5 个 dt>1 退化实验（类别 4）表明，即使完全解决 CIVO，temporal subsampling 本身也带来 40-70% 的性能损失。这对项目的实用价值构成了根本性挑战——CIVO 只是 dt>1 问题的一个维度。
165

# Negative Results 分类清单

总计：**35** 个 negative 实验

## 分类总览

| 类别 | 数量 | 占比 | 代表实验 |
|------|------|------|----------|
| TCN 跨环境/剂量失败 | 10 | 28.6% | exp_030a (Cheetah σ=0.2), exp_031 (PickCube σ=0.2) |
| SGS 干预失败 | 5 | 14.3% | exp_016e (reward-head SGS), exp_018_s2 (full-SGS seed 2) |
| Dual-critic / Wide-critic 跨环境失败 | 5 | 14.3% | exp_034 (Cheetah dual-critic), exp_038 (Walker s2 non-CIVO collapse) |
| dt>1 本身退化 | 5 | 14.3% | exp_007 (fixed dt=4), exp_008f_s4 (no-dt-emb control) |
| CIVO 复现/表征（诊断性 negative） | 4 | 11.4% | exp_009e (CIVO collapse confirmed), exp_008e_v3_s3 (stochastic collapse) |
| Event-gate 机制失败 | 3 | 8.6% | exp_005 (v4 collapse @85K) |
| RAVE 干预失败 | 2 | 5.7% | exp_028 (ceiling=2.0), exp_028_ceil15 (ceiling=1.5) |
| Frozen dt_emb 失败 | 1 | 2.9% | exp_015b (gradient starvation) |

---

## 详细分组

### 类别 1：TCN 跨环境/剂量失败（10 个）

TCN (Temporal Conditioning Noise) 在 Walker σ=0.2 上成功，但在其他环境或剂量下普遍失败。

| exp_id | hypothesis | 环境 | 关键指标 | 简要结论 |
|--------|-----------|------|----------|----------|
| exp_027_tcn_walker_s0 | TCN σ=0.5 抑制 CIVO | Walker | eval peak 240@35K, oscillatory; eval_105K=95.5 | σ=0.5 过量：NVE 一度自修正但后续震荡性 CIVO，eval 大幅波动 |
| exp_027_tcn_walker_s1 | TCN σ=0.5 seed 1 复现 | Walker | eval peak 364.9@75K, last10 mean 233.1 | σ=0.5 跨 seed 不稳定，eval 振幅大（94.6–364.9），不可靠 |
| exp_029b_tcn_walker_s2_sigma02 | TCN σ=0.2 seed 2 方差表征 | Walker | eval peak 177.67@55K, CIVO onset @65K | s0=91% s1=45% s2=collapsed。σ=0.2 在 Walker 上高方差，2/4 seeds 仍崩溃 |
| exp_029c_tcn_walker_s0_sigma01 | σ=0.1 最低有效剂量测试 | Walker | eval peak 490.7@165K, final 328.3 | σ=0.1 未阻止 CIVO（NVE 曾 breach），但最终 eval 尚可；剂量不足以可靠抑制 |
| exp_029d_tcn_walker_s3_sigma02 | TCN σ=0.2 seed 3 统计补充 | Walker | eval peak 349.6@95K, CIVO onset @105K sudden blowup | 健康→突然崩溃（NVE 0.67@95K→3.0@105K），TCN σ=0.2 无法防止晚期 CIVO |
| exp_030a_tcn_cheetah_s0_sigma02 | TCN σ=0.2 跨环境验证 (Cheetah) | Cheetah | eval 299.5@35K→31.9@55K, NVE 1.903@55K | **σ=0.2 对 Cheetah 完全无效**，NVE 直接 breach 1.5×，eval 崩溃 |
| exp_030b_tcn_cheetah_s0_sigma05 | σ=0.5 Cheetah 环境适配剂量 | Cheetah | eval peak ~211.7@125K, NVE peak 10.67@55K | σ=0.5 未抑制 CIVO（NVE 10.67×），eval 长期低迷（68–211，baseline ~548） |
| exp_030c_tcn_cheetah_s0_sigma10 | σ=1.0 Cheetah 高剂量 | Cheetah | eval peak 371.7@35K, final 47.2 | σ=1.0 仍未抑制 Cheetah CIVO，eval 最终崩至 47.2（baseline ~548） |
| exp_031_tcn_pickcube_s0_sigma02 | TCN σ=0.2 跨域验证 (PickCube) | PickCube | eval peak 28.6@162K, NVE peak 3.71 | **PickCube 上 TCN 完全失败**，NVE 3.71×，gate entropy=0（gate 锁死） |
| exp_031b_tcn_pickcube_s0_sigma05 | σ=0.5 PickCube 剂量提升 | PickCube | eval peak 29.1, NVE peak 3.3@42K | σ=0.5 同样失败，NVE 仍达 3.3×，仅在 72.5K 后才被抑制 |

**模式**：TCN 仅在 Walker σ=0.2 的部分 seeds 上有效（~50% success rate）。Cheetah（所有 σ 失败）和 PickCube（σ=0.2/0.5 失败）跨环境泛化彻底失败。表征级干预不足以应对高强度 CIVO。

---

### 类别 2：SGS 干预失败（5 个）

Selective Gradient Stopping（梯度阻断）干预的全面否定——从 reward-head SGS 到 full-SGS 到 obs-decoder SGS，均无法可靠抑制 CIVO。

| exp_id | hypothesis | 环境 | 关键指标 | 简要结论 |
|--------|-----------|------|----------|----------|
| exp_016e_sgs_walker_s1 | Reward-head SGS 阻断 CIVO 梯度通路 | Walker | NVE peak 10.42@95K, eval 31.7@95K | **关键发现**：reward loss 对 dt_emb.weight 梯度贡献=0，reward-head SGS 是 no-op。真正梯度来源是 decoder heads |
| exp_018v2_full_sgs_walker_s1 | Full-SGS 阻断所有 decoder→dt_emb 梯度 | Walker | eval peak 499.6@75K, NVE mean 1.23 (45K-105K), late collapse @112K | CIVO 减少 79% 但未消除；**晚期崩溃** @112K，eval 448→下降 |
| exp_018_full_sgs_s2 | Full-SGS seed 2 可靠性验证 | Walker | eval peak ~488@75K, final 40.8@105K, NVE 1.66@95K | **Seed 2 崩溃**，直接否定 018v2 的结论。Full-SGS 不可靠 |
| exp_021_full_sgs_cheetah_s1 | Full-SGS 跨环境验证 (Cheetah) | Cheetah | NVE peak 9.94@45K, eval final 221.5 (baseline 38.7%) | CIVO 类型=transient_self_correcting，NVE 仍达 9.94×。比 baseline 好 4.3× 但远未达标 |
| exp_025_obs_sgs_walker_s2 | Obs-decoder-only SGS | Walker | VE ratio 0.8-1.4, eval 66-90 (baseline ~930) | CIVO 部分抑制但 **eval 仅 baseline 7-10%**。obs-decoder SGS 摧毁性能同时未消除 CIVO |

**模式**：梯度干预路线全面否定。Full-SGS 0/3 seeds 可靠，Obs-decoder SGS 0/6 有效。关键洞察：CIVO 的梯度来源不是 reward head 而是 decoder heads（016e 发现），但即使阻断全部 decoder 梯度也只是延迟而非消除 CIVO。

---

### 类别 3：Dual-critic / Wide-critic 跨环境失败（5 个）

架构级干预（双 critic / 宽 critic）在部分环境有效但跨环境泛化存在问题。

| exp_id | hypothesis | 环境 | 关键指标 | 简要结论 |
|--------|-----------|------|----------|----------|
| exp_034 | Dual-critic 抑制 Cheetah CIVO | Cheetah | eval peak 315.7, final 97.5, NVE peak 1.753 | CIVO 未被阻止（两次 CIVO trigger @55K/105K），v1/v2 divergence 仅 0.004（双 critic 几乎无差异） |
| exp_034_dual_critic_cheetah | Dual-critic Cheetah（TCN 全失败后的架构级干预） | Cheetah | eval peak 315.7@45K, final 97.5, dual-wave CIVO | **双波 CIVO**：CIVO 被短暂抑制后二次爆发。Cheetah 上架构级干预也失败 |
| exp_036_dual_critic_pickcube | Dual-critic PickCube | PickCube | eval peak 27.7, final 27.7, NVE peak 2.3 | CIVO 被标记 prevented（NVE 终值 0.2）但 eval 极低（27.7），gate 锁死 dt=2。功能性失败 |
| exp_037_wide_critic_cheetah | Wide single critic (容量假说) Cheetah | Cheetah | eval peak 350.1, final 146.1, NVE peak 3.6 | NVE 仍达 3.6×（baseline 70.64×减至 3.6× 但远未消除），eval 崩至 146.1 |
| exp_038_dual_critic_walker_s2 | Dual-critic Walker seed 2 统计补充 | Walker | eval peak 354@155K, **collapse to 99.6@175K**, NVE≤0.3 | **Non-CIVO collapse**：CIVO 被阻止（NVE≤0.3）但 eval 仍崩溃至 99.6，暴露非 CIVO 退化机制 |

**模式**：Dual-critic 在 Walker 2/3 seeds 有效但第三 seed 暴露 non-CIVO collapse。Cheetah 上完全失败（双 critic 几乎无差异化）。PickCube 上 CIVO 指标好但功能性 eval 极差。架构级干预也非万能。

---

### 类别 4：dt>1 本身退化（5 个）

temporal subsampling 自身导致的性能退化，与 CIVO 无关——即使没有 CIVO 现象，dt>1 也带来显著性能损失。

| exp_id | hypothesis | 环境 | 关键指标 | 简要结论 |
|--------|-----------|------|----------|----------|
| exp_006_fixed_dt2 | Fixed dt=2 诊断（无 learned gate） | Walker | eval peak 485.3@35K, 65K 崩至 132.86 | dt=2 本身导致崩溃，非 gate 机制问题。VE ratio @65K=3.67 |
| exp_007_fixed_dt4 | Fixed dt=4 诊断 | Walker | eval peak 176.9@25K, 45K=144 (baseline 443) | dt=4 性能显著低于 baseline，进程 12.5min 后异常退出 |
| exp_008c_no_subsample_dt2_h8 | Subsample OFF + dt=2 imagination + H=8 | Walker | eval plateau ~241@55K-65K (baseline 616@65K) | 无 subsample 下 dt=2 imagination 也只达 baseline 39%，compounding error 是瓶颈 |
| exp_008f_s4 | No-dt-emb 控制组 seed 4 | Walker | eval 306.5@105K, peak 487.5@55K (baseline ~930) | 无 CIVO（NVE 0.58）但 eval 仅 baseline 33%。移除 dt_emb 避免 CIVO 但代价是巨大性能损失 |
| exp_009c_008f_walker_s2 | No-dt-emb 控制组 seed 2 | Walker | eval 148.34@105K, peak 359@75K | 比 seed 1（503@105K）更差，**无 dt_emb 方案 seed 方差极大且性能不可接受** |

**模式**：dt>1 即使在最优配置下（fixed dt、no gate、no dt_emb）也带来 40-70% 的性能损失。这是 temporal subsampling 的根本局限——RSSM 对 dt>1 的多步预测质量不足，compounding error 随 horizon 累积。

---

### 类别 5：CIVO 复现/表征（诊断性 negative）（4 个）

这些实验的 negative 结论是因为它们确认了 CIVO 现象的存在和严重性，是诊断性实验而非干预实验。

| exp_id | hypothesis | 环境 | 关键指标 | 简要结论 |
|--------|-----------|------|----------|----------|
| exp_009e_008d_walker_s1 | 008d CIVO 复现（seed 1 延长至 105K） | Walker | NVE 4.13@55K, eval 131.08@105K | CIVO collapse 确认：eval 从正常水平崩至 131，actor_loss 翻正@85K |
| exp_009b_008d_walker_s2 | 008d CIVO 复现（seed 2） | Walker | NVE peak 1.62@45K (transient), eval 268 | CIVO 未复现（self-corrected），但 eval 仍远低于 baseline。NVE>1.5× threshold 可靠但 collapse 是随机的 |
| exp_008e_v3_s3 | dt=1/H=15 多 seed 验证 | Walker | NVE 4.02@105K, eval 92.7, collapse @85K-95K | dt=1 配置仍出现 CIVO collapse（1/3 seeds），证明 CIVO 是随机性的 |
| exp_008e_v3_walker_s2 | dt=1/H=15 seed 2 crown jewel 验证 | Walker | eval peak 715@85K→137@105K, NVE 3.78× | C6 配置 collapse：即使 gate 锁定 dt=1，1/3 seeds 仍崩溃。Collapse 是随机的 |

**模式**：CIVO 是随机性事件（30-50% 发生率），即使在最保守配置（dt=1）下仍可发生。NVE>1.5× 是可靠的早期预警指标，但 collapse 发生与否有随机性。

---

### 类别 6：Event-gate 机制失败（3 个）

项目最初提出的 event-gated adaptive horizon 核心机制的早期失败。

| exp_id | hypothesis | 环境 | 关键指标 | 简要结论 |
|--------|-----------|------|----------|----------|
| exp_003_event_gated_v2 | Event-gated v2 | Walker | eval 92.3-118.7@105K-115K, gate entropy ratio 0.796 | C1 return FAIL (baseline 0.13×)，gate 分布有多样性但 return 极低 |
| exp_004_event_gated_v3 | 修复 imagination dt 约束后的 v3 | Walker | — | 修复 logits masking 后仍失败 |
| exp_005_event_gated_v4 | Learned gate 改善 sample efficiency | Walker | eval peak 541.18@55K→98.84@145K (baseline ~950) | 早期有希望（55K 达 541）但后期崩溃至 98.84。Gate mean 收敛到 ~2.0，学习不稳定 |

**模式**：Learned gate 机制从 v2 到 v4 持续失败。核心问题：gate 的 dt>1 选择引入 CIVO 现象，而 gate 本身无法学会规避这一问题。这一失败直接催生了 CIVO 研究方向的转向。

---

### 类别 7：RAVE 干预失败（2 个）

Reality-Anchored Value Estimation（直接 clip value ratio）的失败。

| exp_id | hypothesis | 环境 | 关键指标 | 简要结论 |
|--------|-----------|------|----------|----------|
| exp_028_rave_walker_s0 | RAVE ceiling=2.0 cap imagination value | Walker | eval peak 204.6, 105K=29, VE ratio 3.183@105K | **RAVE 完全失败**：ceiling=2.0 未阻止 VE ratio 上升至 3.183，eval 崩至 29 |
| exp_028_rave_walker_s0_ceil15 | RAVE ceiling=1.5 更激进 cap | Walker | eval peak 180.1@35K, 135K=39.1 | Tighter ceiling 同样失败，eval 持续下降至 39.1。Value capping 无法解决根因 |

**模式**：直接 clip value ratio 不仅未能抑制 CIVO，反而可能干扰正常的 value 学习。CIVO 的根因不在 value 数值大小，而在 value 的结构性偏差。

---

### 类别 8：Frozen dt_emb 失败（1 个）

冻结 dt_emb 权重的因果诊断实验。

| exp_id | hypothesis | 环境 | 关键指标 | 简要结论 |
|--------|-----------|------|----------|----------|
| exp_015b_frozen_dt_emb | Frozen dt_emb 隔离训练 vs 存在的因果效应 | Walker | eval 204.2@105K, peak 211.2@65K (baseline ~930) | **Gradient starvation**：冻结 dt_emb 导致 actor_loss 接近 0（0.000179@105K），entropy 异常低（-4.855）。证明 dt_emb 训练对正常学习是必要的 |

**模式**：不能通过冻结 dt_emb 来避免 CIVO——dt_emb 的梯度流对整体学习至关重要，阻断它会导致 gradient starvation。

---

## 跨类别观察

### 1. 干预层级递进失败链
项目经历了清晰的干预层级递进：**梯度级（SGS）→ 表征级（TCN）→ 值函数级（RAVE）→ 架构级（dual-critic）**。每一级都因不同原因失败，揭示 CIVO 是一个多层面问题：
- 梯度阻断（SGS）：延迟但不消除 CIVO
- 噪声注入（TCN）：环境敏感、剂量窗口极窄
- 值裁剪（RAVE）：未触及根因
- 架构冗余（dual-critic）：Cheetah 上双 critic 无差异化，Walker 上暴露 non-CIVO collapse

### 2. 环境依赖性是系统性障碍
几乎所有干预方法都表现出强烈的环境依赖性。在 Walker 上部分有效的方法迁移到 Cheetah（更强 CIVO）或 PickCube（不同动力学）后失败。这表明 CIVO 的严重程度和机制可能因环境而异。

### 3. CIVO 的随机性本质
即使在相同配置下，CIVO collapse 也只在 30-50% 的 seeds 上发生（exp_008e_v3 系列：3 seeds 中 1 个 collapse；exp_029 系列：4 seeds 中 2 个 collapse）。这意味着单 seed 实验无法可靠判断干预是否有效。

### 4. 非 CIVO 退化机制
exp_038 揭示了一个重要盲点：成功抑制 CIVO（NVE≤0.3）后仍可能出现 eval collapse。这说明 dt>1 imagination 还存在 CIVO 以外的退化机制，可能与 compounding error 或 policy exploration 相关。

### 5. dt>1 的根本性限制
5 个 dt>1 退化实验（类别 4）表明，即使完全解决 CIVO，temporal subsampling 本身也带来 40-70% 的性能损失。这对项目的实用价值构成了根本性挑战——CIVO 只是 dt>1 问题的一个维度。

Introduction\\n- Temporal abstraction is a long-sought goal in RL (options, macro-actions, skip connections)\\n- World-model RL (DreamerV3) offers a natural testbed: modify imagination dt without changing environment interaction\\n- Puzzle: all our attempts at variable-rate imagination degrade performance. Why?\\n- Contribution: systematic factorial diagnosis identifying trained dt_embedding as the reliable trigger for conditioning-induced value overestimation (CIVO, nve>1.5x), with collapse as a stochastic consequence. The vulnerability is deeper than imagination quality — even dt=1 imagination collapses at the same rate when dt_embedding is trained, revealing that training data dt>1 transitions alone drive the critic exploitation feedback loop\\n\\n### 2. Background & Related Work\\n- Temporal abstraction in model-free RL (options framework, FiGAR, action repeat)\\n- World-model RL (Dreamer family, IRIS, TWM)\\n- Variable-rate planning in world models (few prior works, mostly positive framing)\\n- Value overestimation in model-based RL (delusional bias per Lu et al. 2018 — differentiate from our CIVO)\\n\\n### 3. Methodology\\n- DreamerV3 as base architecture\\n- Variable-rate imagination: dt_embedding, temporal subsampling, learned gating\\n- **Factorial experiment design**: 2×2×2 grid (dt_embedding trained/untrained × subsample ON/OFF × H=8/15) + baselines\\n- Diagnostic metrics: eval return, value/eval ratio as overestimation proxy, learning curves\\n\\n### 4. Results\\n- **Finding 1**: All dt>1 configurations degrade (C1)\\n- **Finding 2**: Controlled ablation isolates trained dt_embedding (C2) — the \\\"smoking gun\\\" comparison (008c vs 008d)\\n- **Finding 3**: Untrained dt_embedding prevents optimistic drift, sustaining near-baseline performance (C3)\\n- **Finding 4**: Longer dt amplifies (C4)\\n- **Finding 5**: Horizon/subsample effects are secondary (C5)\\n- **Finding 6 (partially falsified)**: dt=1 imagination does not prevent collapse (1/2 seeds), but collapsed seed (008e_v3_s2) shows non-CIVO dynamics (eval-driven, entropy ↑) unlike 008d's classic CIVO (value-driven, entropy ↓). 009a baseline s2 stable → collapse is config-caused. Trained dt_embedding creates vulnerability through multiple pathways, not solely through value overestimation (C6, D040)\\n\\n### 5. Discussion\\n- Mechanism: why trained dt_embedding causes CIVO (RSSM fidelity gap at dt>1)\\n- RSSM fidelity analysis: 008d reward gap (2.78x) vs 008f reward gap (1.01x)\\n- **D040: Multiple vulnerability pathways**: Pathway A (CIVO, value-driven) + Pathway B (non-CIVO policy instability, eval-driven)\\n- **D107: Gradient-level interventions fail entirely**: SGS 0/3 (full) + 1/6 (obs-decoder) + 0/2 (reward-only) = backward-pass is categorically insufficient. Gradient magnitude ≠ causal importance (reward 38-49% but reward-only SGS fails worst; obs-decoder 16-22% but targeted SGS also fails). Forward-pass representational damage is the irreducible floor.\\n- **Compensatory amplification**: Blocking obs-decoder on Cheetah → 2.6-3.6× NVE amplification vs untreated. Blocking reward → obs-decoder reliance increases → spatial bias reinforced.\\n- **Universal value collapse**: Obs-decoder SGS degrades all seeds' critic calibration (ve_ratio 0.056-0.14 @215K), including CIVO-free seeds. \\\"Protection\\\" = trading overestimation for underestimation.\\n- **Fourth CIVO trajectory (s3)**: Latent onset → delayed collapse → policy recovery → persistent value collapse. CIVO-induced critic damage may be irreversible.\\n- MPC vs imagination: TAWM succeeds because MPC re-plans from real states; imagination-based critic bootstrapping creates the positive feedback loop\\n- **D032: Value self-correction mechanism (009b)**: Transient vs sustained nve>1.5x determines outcome. Early stochasticity (initialization, data sampling) is the gate.\\n\\n### 6. Implications for Future Work\\n- **D113: Intervention Hierarchy — all three levels fail or partially fail**: Gradient (SGS 1/17), Output (RAVE 0/2), Representation (TCN 2/8 with high variance). dt_embedding removal 5/5 but removes the feature entirely.\\n- TCN existence proof (Walker σ=0.2) shows mitigation is *possible in principle* but fragile — narrow dose window, environment-dependent, high seed variance in eval retention\\n- **Dose-environment dependency**: No universal σ exists; Walker-effective dose (σ=0.2) underdoses Cheetah/PickCube, Walker-overdose (σ=0.5) still underdoses Cheetah\\n- RSSM prediction quality must improve before variable-rate imagination is viable\\n- Hierarchical temporal abstraction (THICK, Hieros) may avoid flat-conditioning failure by maintaining separate dynamics per temporal scale\\n- Need for diagnostic methodology in temporal abstraction research\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns\\n\\n### R1: \\\"Limited to one environment / one base algorithm\\\"\\n**Pre-emption**: Our claims are mechanistic (trained dt_embedding → value overestimation → collapse). Introduction\\n- Temporal abstraction is a long-sought goal in RL (options, macro-actions, skip connections)\\n- World-model RL (DreamerV3) offers a natural testbed: modify imagination dt without changing environment interaction\\n- Puzzle: all our attempts at variable-rate imagination degrade performance. Why?\\n- Contribution: systematic factorial diagnosis identifying trained dt_embedding as the reliable trigger for conditioning-induced value overestimation (CIVO, nve>1.5x), with collapse as a stochastic consequence. The vulnerability is deeper than imagination quality — even dt=1 imagination collapses at the same rate when dt_embedding is trained, revealing that training data dt>1 transitions alone drive the critic exploitation feedback loop\\n\\n### 2. Background & Related Work\\n- Temporal abstraction in model-free RL (options framework, FiGAR, action repeat)\\n- World-model RL (Dreamer family, IRIS, TWM)\\n- Variable-rate planning in world models (few prior works, mostly positive framing)\\n- Value overestimation in model-based RL (delusional bias per Lu et al. 2018 — differentiate from our CIVO)\\n\\n### 3. Methodology\\n- DreamerV3 as base architecture\\n- Variable-rate imagination: dt_embedding, temporal subsampling, learned gating\\n- **Factorial experiment design**: 2×2×2 grid (dt_embedding trained/untrained × subsample ON/OFF × H=8/15) + baselines\\n- Diagnostic metrics: eval return, value/eval ratio as overestimation proxy, learning curves\\n\\n### 4. Results\\n- **Finding 1**: All dt>1 configurations degrade (C1)\\n- **Finding 2**: Controlled ablation isolates trained dt_embedding (C2) — the \\\"smoking gun\\\" comparison (008c vs 008d)\\n- **Finding 3**: Untrained dt_embedding prevents optimistic drift, sustaining near-baseline performance (C3)\\n- **Finding 4**: Longer dt amplifies (C4)\\n- **Finding 5**: Horizon/subsample effects are secondary (C5)\\n- **Finding 6 (partially falsified)**: dt=1 imagination does not prevent collapse (1/2 seeds), but collapsed seed (008e_v3_s2) shows non-CIVO dynamics (eval-driven, entropy ↑) unlike 008d's classic CIVO (value-driven, entropy ↓). 009a baseline s2 stable → collapse is config-caused. Trained dt_embedding creates vulnerability through multiple pathways, not solely through value overestimation (C6, D040)\\n\\n### 5. Discussion\\n- Mechanism: why trained dt_embedding causes CIVO (RSSM fidelity gap at dt>1)\\n- RSSM fidelity analysis: 008d reward gap (2.78x) vs 008f reward gap (1.01x)\\n- **D040: Multiple vulnerability pathways**: Pathway A (CIVO, value-driven) + Pathway B (non-CIVO policy instability, eval-driven)\\n- **D107: Gradient-level interventions fail entirely**: SGS 0/3 (full) + 1/6 (obs-decoder) + 0/2 (reward-only) = backward-pass is categorically insufficient. Gradient magnitude ≠ causal importance (reward 38-49% but reward-only SGS fails worst; obs-decoder 16-22% but targeted SGS also fails). Forward-pass representational damage is the irreducible floor.\\n- **Compensatory amplification**: Blocking obs-decoder on Cheetah → 2.6-3.6× NVE amplification vs untreated. Blocking reward → obs-decoder reliance increases → spatial bias reinforced.\\n- **Universal value collapse**: Obs-decoder SGS degrades all seeds' critic calibration (ve_ratio 0.056-0.14 @215K), including CIVO-free seeds. \\\"Protection\\\" = trading overestimation for underestimation.\\n- **Fourth CIVO trajectory (s3)**: Latent onset → delayed collapse → policy recovery → persistent value collapse. CIVO-induced critic damage may be irreversible.\\n- MPC vs imagination: TAWM succeeds because MPC re-plans from real states; imagination-based critic bootstrapping creates the positive feedback loop\\n- **D032: Value self-correction mechanism (009b)**: Transient vs sustained nve>1.5x determines outcome. Early stochasticity (initialization, data sampling) is the gate.\\n\\n### 6. Implications for Future Work\\n- **D113: Intervention Hierarchy — all three levels fail or partially fail**: Gradient (SGS 1/17), Output (RAVE 0/2), Representation (TCN 2/8 with high variance). dt_embedding removal 5/5 but removes the feature entirely.\\n- TCN existence proof (Walker σ=0.2) shows mitigation is *possible in principle* but fragile — narrow dose window, environment-dependent, high seed variance in eval retention\\n- **Dose-environment dependency**: No universal σ exists; Walker-effective dose (σ=0.2) underdoses Cheetah/PickCube, Walker-overdose (σ=0.5) still underdoses Cheetah\\n- RSSM prediction quality must improve before variable-rate imagination is viable\\n- Hierarchical temporal abstraction (THICK, Hieros) may avoid flat-conditioning failure by maintaining separate dynamics per temporal scale\\n- Need for diagnostic methodology in temporal abstraction research\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns\\n\\n### R1: \\\"Limited to one environment / one base algorithm\\\"\\n**Pre-emption**: Our claims are mechanistic (trained dt_embedding → value overestimation → collapse). The mechanism (RSSM fidelity gap) likely generalizes to other latent-dynamics models but we scope claims conservatively.\\n**Mitigation**: Cheetah Run is a planned experiment in our experiment schedule, not a stretch goal. We will include at least one additional DMC environment (Cheetah Run) to demonstrate generality of the mechanism.\\n\\n### R2: \\\"No proposed solution — what's the actionable takeaway?\\\"\\n**Pre-emption**: Our primary contribution is diagnostic, not prescriptive. Beyond diagnosis, we provide a **systematic Intervention Hierarchy** evaluating 7+ methods across 3 levels (gradient/output/representation) and 3 environments. This is the most comprehensive evaluation of CIVO interventions to date. The key finding: even the most promising intervention (TCN, representation-level) succeeds only under narrow conditions (Walker σ=0.2, 2/8 configs, 45-91% eval retention). The actionable takeaway is that CIVO requires fundamental architectural solutions (hierarchical temporal abstraction per THICK/Hieros), not post-hoc interventions.\\n**Mitigation**: The Intervention Hierarchy table (7 methods × 3 levels) is a standalone contribution — it saves future researchers from re-exploring these dead ends and provides a systematic framework for evaluating future interventions.\\n\\n### R3: \\\"Value/eval ratio is a crude proxy for overestimation\\\"\\n**Pre-emption**: We acknowledge this is a proxy, not a formal divergence measure. ## Title Candidates

1. **"Why Temporal Abstraction Fails in DreamerV3: A Diagnostic Analysis of Variable-Rate Imagination"**
2. ~~**"The Delusional Critic Problem in DreamerV3's Variable-Rate Imagination"**~~ (deprecated — "delusional critic" conflicts with Lu et al. 2018)
3. **"Diagnosing Value Overestimation from Temporal Abstraction in DreamerV3"** ← preferred after D037 terminology decision
4. **"Conditioning-Induced Value Overestimation in Variable-Rate World-Model Imagination"**

**⚠️ D037 术语决定**: "delusional critic" → **"conditioning-induced value overestimation"** (简称 CIVO)。Lu et al. 2018 的 delusional bias 指 policy-class constraints 导致不可实现的 Q 值，本文机制是 model imprecision + learned conditioning amplification，概念不同。Dream 模拟三档审稿一致指出术语误导。全文替换："delusional critic" → "conditioning-induced value overestimation"，可 cite Lu et al. 2018 as analogy but must explicitly differentiate。

**⚠️ D037 TAWM 对比（关键 novelty 升级）**: TAWM (Nhu et al., ICML 2025) 在 TD-MPC2 (MPC setting) 中成功使用 dt-conditioning。本文发现 dt-conditioning 在 imagination-based actor-critic 中失败 → **novelty 从 "known failure class 的 specific instance" 升级为 "dt-conditioning succeeds in MPC but fails in imagination — here's the architecture-specific vulnerability"**。TAWM 是强化 novelty 的最关键参考文献。

## Venue

**ICML 2026** — Deadline: 2026-05-29

## Narrative Positioning

This is a **diagnostic analysis paper**, not a method paper. We do not propose a new algorithm. Instead, we provide a systematic, controlled investigation answering: *Why does temporal abstraction fail in world-model RL?*

The contribution is a **strongly supported causal chain** from mechanism to failure mode, backed by a factorial experiment design that isolates each factor, plus a **practical mitigation guideline** (restrict imagination to dt=1 during multi-dt training → 95% baseline recovery). Diagnostic papers are valued when they (a) address a widely-attempted but poorly-understood failure, (b) provide actionable insight for future method design, and (c) are methodologically rigorous.

We scope all claims to **DreamerV3 and its RSSM world model**. Generalizability to other latent-dynamics architectures is discussed but not claimed.

---

## Core Claims

### C1: Variable-rate imagination in DreamerV3 consistently degrades performance

Temporal abstraction via variable dt—whether learned or fixed—degrades asymptotic performance relative to the dt=1 baseline across all tested configurations.

| Evidence | Experiment | Key Metric |
|----------|-----------|------------|
| Baseline stability | exp_001_baseline (dt=1) | Stable convergence ~950 eval return |
| Fixed dt=2 collapse | exp_006_fixed_dt2 (dt=2, subsample ON, H=15) | Peak 485@35K → collapse to ~135@65K |
| Fixed dt=4 severe degradation | exp_007_fixed_dt4 (dt=4) | Peak 176.9@25K, 144.4@45K (33% of baseline@45K=443) |
| Learned gate collapse | exp_005 (learned gate) | Peak 541@55K → 99@145K |

**Strength**: Strong. Three independent dt>1 configurations all show degradation. No positive result exists for variable-rate imagination in our setup.

### C2: Trained dt_embedding reliably triggers pathological value overestimation (>1.5x), creating high collapse risk

**D032 update: nve>1.5x threshold has perfect separating power (4/4); collapse itself is stochastic.**

The trained dt_embedding reliably induces pathological value overestimation (normalized v/e >1.5x baseline) across all tested seeds, but whether this overestimation progresses to catastrophic performance collapse is stochastic:

- **WITH trained dt_emb**: 2/2 seeds exceed nve>1.5x at 35K+ (008d seed 1: sustained 1.71x@35K→2.09x@45K→4.12x@55K → collapse; 009b seed 2: 1.62x@45K → self-correction to 0.38x@105K)
- **WITHOUT dt_emb (008f)**: 0/2 seeds exceed nve>1.5x at 35K+ (seed 1 peak 1.02x@25K; seed 2 peak 1.26x@25K)
- **1.5x threshold (35K+)**: 4/4 perfect classification — reliable diagnostic marker separating trained vs untrained dt_emb

**⚠️ 时间限定**: nve>1.5x 诊断适用于 **35K+ steps**（此时 baseline v/e 已充分收敛至 >0.24，比率稳定可靠）。25K 处 baseline v/e 仅 0.087，微小绝对差异可被放大为大比率（如 009b@25K nve=2.05x 和 008e_v3@25K nve=1.93x 均为 false positive）。论文中报告 threshold 时必须标注此限定。

**Sustained vs transient overestimation**: The key difference between collapse (008d seed 1) and self-correction (009b seed 2) is the **temporal persistence** of nve>1.5x. Seed 1 maintained nve>1.5x across 3 consecutive checkpoints at 35K+ (1.71x@35K→2.09x@45K→4.12x@55K, accelerating), locking the positive feedback loop; seed 2 exceeded 1.5x at 45K (1.62x) but dropped to 1.41x@55K and continued declining, allowing self-correction. This suggests a "point of no return" where sustained overestimation becomes irreversible, with early training stochasticity (initialization, data sampling order) determining which path is taken (cf. Henderson et al. 2018, Bjorck et al. 2022, Qiao et al. 2023).

The trained dt_embedding enables precise dt prediction in imagination, but RSSM state prediction quality at dt>1 is insufficient to support this precision. The result is conditioning-induced value overestimation (CIVO) that drives actor learning toward incorrect policies. Without dt_embedding conditioning, the overestimation feedback loop is blocked entirely (nve never exceeds 1.5x).

|----------|-----------|------------|

**dt_emb Gradient Decomposition (D061) — ⚠️ 已修正**

梯度验证（torch.autograd.grad analysis, correct config gate_fixed_dt=2）揭示 dt_emb.weight 的梯度来源分布：

**Strength**: Moderate-strong (D032 update: causal direction + diagnostic marker confirmed; collapse stochastic). The **nve>1.5x threshold** achieves 4/4 perfect separation: all trained dt_emb seeds (008d, 009b) exceed 1.5x; no untrained seeds (008f, 009c) exceed 1.5x. This is the paper's strongest quantitative result for C2. **Collapse** is stochastic (1/2 trained seeds): 008d seed 1 shows sustained nve>1.5x → collapse; 009b seed 2 shows transient nve>1.5x → self-correction. The **causal direction** is unambiguous across all 4 data points. Pending: 009e (008d seed 1) to determine collapse probability (1/3 vs 2/3); 009f (008f seed 1) for third untrained seed; 009c extension to 200K.

### C3: Untrained dt_embedding prevents optimistic drift, substantively protecting performance

When dt_embedding is untrained (random fixed), the value function cannot exploit precise dt information, preventing the optimistic value drift seen in trained variants. This value growth suppression substantively protects performance: exp_008a demonstrates two complete zigzag recovery cycles over 105K steps (peak @105K=778, 85% of baseline 916), with normalized v/e consistently suppressed at 0.59-0.93x baseline. The trained dt_embedding variant (exp_006) collapses catastrophically as its v/e ratio accelerates far past baseline levels (2.3x baseline@55K).

| Evidence | Experiment | Key Metric |
|----------|-----------|------------|

This is structural value growth suppression, not a transient delay. Contrasts sharply with exp_006's accelerating v/e (1.6x→2.3x baseline → collapse). The mechanism is clear: untrained dt_embedding prevents the value function from exploiting precise (but wrong) dt>1 predictions, suppressing the optimistic value drift that drives the CIVO feedback loop in trained variants.

**Diagnostic metric: v/e overshoot ratio** = experiment v/e / baseline v/e at same training step. >1.5x = pathological warning. Trained dt_emb variants: 008d@35K=1.7x, @45K=2.1x; 006@45K=1.6x, @55K=2.3x. Untrained: 008a normalized v/e range 0.59-0.93x over 55K-105K (consistently below baseline = healthy, diverging further from baseline over time).

**105K long-run confirmed**: exp_008a ran to 112K steps. Normalized v/e at 105K=0.59x baseline (lowest point), confirming value growth suppression is structural, not a transient delay. The suppression strengthens over time rather than converging to baseline levels.

### C4: Longer dt amplifies the problem

Increasing dt from 2 to 4 worsens degradation, consistent with RSSM prediction error compounding over longer temporal gaps.

| Monotonic relationship | dt=1 (~950) > dt=2 (peak 485@35K) > dt=4 (peak 177@25K) | Clear monotonic decline |

**Strength**: Moderate. Only two dt values tested (2 and 4). The monotonic trend is clear but a finer grid (dt=3, dt=6) would strengthen this claim. Sufficient for a supporting claim but not a standalone finding.

### C5: Learning signal reduction from shorter effective horizons compounds degradation but is not the root cause

Subsampling with dt>1 reduces the effective number of learning transitions per episode. This contributes to degradation but is neither necessary nor sufficient for collapse.

The 008c vs 008a comparison shows horizon length matters independently. exp_008e_v3 confirms subsample ON does not trigger collapse when imagination is restricted to dt=1, even with trained dt_emb. ### C7: Gradient-level interventions fail to eliminate CIVO — gradient magnitude decoupled from causal importance

**⚠️ D107: SGS 全面失败，梯度干预不是正确的干预层级**

All three SGS variants fail to eliminate CIVO:
- **Reward-only SGS** (016e): 0/2, NVE=10.42× — paradoxically worse than untreated
- **Full-pathway SGS** (018+021): 0/3 across two environments — blocks all non-KL gradients, still fails
- **Obs-decoder-only SGS** (025+026): 1/6 across two environments — the identified causal channel, still fails

| Evidence | Experiment | Key Metric |
|----------|-----------|------------|
| Reward-only SGS 反效果 | exp_016e | NVE=10.42×, collapse to eval 31.7. 阻断 reward 梯度迫使 dt_emb 通过 obs-decoder 适配，强化空间偏差 |
| Full SGS 0/3 | exp_018 (Walker 2 seeds) + exp_021 (Cheetah 1 seed) | s1: eval 448.3, NVE 1.66× (CIVO+); s2: collapse 40.8; Cheetah: transient NVE 9.94×→0.34× (not SGS effect) |
| Obs-decoder SGS 1/6 | exp_025 (Walker 4 seeds) + exp_026 (Cheetah 2 seeds) | Walker: 1/4 (s1 survived, s2-s4 collapsed); Cheetah: 0/2, NVE 21.9×-30.2× (2.6-3.6× worse than untreated 8.3×) |
| Compensatory amplification (Cheetah) | exp_026 vs exp_010b | Obs-decoder SGS NVE 21.9-30.2× vs untreated 8.3× — blocking obs-decoder shifts co-adaptation to reward head |
| Universal value collapse | exp_025 all seeds @215K | All 4 seeds terminal ve_ratio=0.056-0.14, including s1 "success" (eval 726, value 41) — critic underestimation as side effect |
| Fourth trajectory (s3) | exp_025_s3 | Healthy@105K → CIVO@135K (NVE 6.8×) → eval recovery (590@215K) → persistent value collapse (ve_ratio 0.14) |

**核心发现**：
1. **梯度量级与因果重要性脱耦**: Reward head 38-49% 梯度占比（最大），但 reward-only SGS 失败最惨；obs decoder 16-22%（最小非零），但 obs-decoder SGS 也失败。梯度分解成功作为**诊断工具**但失败作为**干预指南**。
2. **Backward-pass 是错误的干预层级**: Full SGS 阻断所有非 KL 梯度仍 0/3 → forward-pass representational damage 是不可约减的脆弱性底线。Temporal embedding 通过 forward pass 塑造潜在表示，无论哪些梯度更新它。
3. **补偿放大**: 阻断任一通道导致剩余通道放大 co-adaptation（Cheetah: 2.6-3.6× 放大）。
4. **SGS 副作用**: 即使"成功"的 seed 也遭受 critic 校准损坏（universal value collapse）。

**Strength**: Strong. 17 seeds across 3 SGS variants and 2 environments. Only 1/17 avoids CIVO, and that seed still suffers value collapse. Embedding removal (008f+024b): 5/5 = 100% prevention. The contrast establishes gradient stopping as categorically insufficient.

### C8: Forward-pass interventions — TCN and RAVE (🔄 验证中)

**⚠️ D107/D108: 两种 forward-pass 干预方法并行验证**

SGS 失败的根因是 backward-pass 干预无法消除 forward-pass representational damage。C8 提出绕过梯度冗余的 forward-pass 干预：

**TCN (Temporal Conditioning Noise)**:
- 设计理念：imagination 时对 dt_embedding 输出加高斯噪声 $\mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2)$，降低 conditioning 精度
- 机制假说：噪声阻止 RSSM 和 critic 对精确 dt 信号的过度 co-adaptation，同时保留粗粒度时间信息
- 与 SGS 的区别：在 forward pass 层面操作，不依赖梯度阻断
- 超参：σ=0.5×std（主实验）+ σ=0.2×std（替代超参）
- 实验：exp_027_tcn_walker_s0 (σ=0.5), exp_027_tcn_walker_s0_sigma02 (σ=0.2)

**RAVE (Reality-Anchored Value Estimation)**:
- 设计理念：用 EMA 跟踪真实环境状态的值估计，当 imagined value 超过 EMA×ceiling 时截断
- 机制假说：直接限制 critic overestimation 的幅度，打断 CIVO 正反馈循环
- 与 SGS 的区别：不修改梯度流，而是在 value estimate 层面施加约束
- 超参：ceiling=2.0（主实验）+ ceiling=1.5（替代超参）
- 实验：exp_028_rave_walker_s0 (ceil=2.0), exp_028_rave_walker_s0_ceil15 (ceil=1.5)

**D113 全面评估完成 (2026-05-20) — Scenario B 确认：Intervention Hierarchy 论文**

TCN 跨环境 universal mitigation（Scenario A）已关闭。TCN 仅在 Walker σ=0.2 成功（2/8 configs），且 eval 保留高度不稳定（91%/45% across seeds）。论文核心转为 **Intervention Hierarchy**：三层干预（Gradient → Output → Representation）系统性评估，证明 CIVO fundamentally hard to mitigate。

## Story Arc

### 1. Introduction
- Temporal abstraction is a long-sought goal in RL (options, macro-actions, skip connections)
- World-model RL (DreamerV3) offers a natural testbed: modify imagination dt without changing environment interaction
- Puzzle: all our attempts at variable-rate imagination degrade performance. Why?
- Contribution: systematic factorial diagnosis identifying trained dt_embedding as the reliable trigger for conditioning-induced value overestimation (CIVO, nve>1.5x), with collapse as a stochastic consequence. The vulnerability is deeper than imagination quality — even dt=1 imagination collapses at the same rate when dt_embedding is trained, revealing that training data dt>1 transitions alone drive the critic exploitation feedback loop

### 2. Background & Related Work
- Temporal abstraction in model-free RL (options framework, FiGAR, action repeat)
- World-model RL (Dreamer family, IRIS, TWM)
- Variable-rate planning in world models (few prior works, mostly positive framing)
- Value overestimation in model-based RL (delusional bias per Lu et al. 2018 — differentiate from our CIVO)

### 3. Methodology
- DreamerV3 as base architecture
- Variable-rate imagination: dt_embedding, temporal subsampling, learned gating
- **Factorial experiment design**: 2×2×2 grid (dt_embedding trained/untrained × subsample ON/OFF × H=8/15) + baselines
- Diagnostic metrics: eval return, value/eval ratio as overestimation proxy, learning curves

### 4. Results
- **Finding 1**: All dt>1 configurations degrade (C1)
- **Finding 2**: Controlled ablation isolates trained dt_embedding (C2) — the "smoking gun" comparison (008c vs 008d)
- **Finding 3**: Untrained dt_embedding prevents optimistic drift, sustaining near-baseline performance (C3)
- **Finding 4**: Longer dt amplifies (C4)
- **Finding 5**: Horizon/subsample effects are secondary (C5)
- **Finding 6 (partially falsified)**: dt=1 imagination does not prevent collapse (1/2 seeds), but collapsed seed (008e_v3_s2) shows non-CIVO dynamics (eval-driven, entropy ↑) unlike 008d's classic CIVO (value-driven, entropy ↓). 009a baseline s2 stable → collapse is config-caused. Trained dt_embedding creates vulnerability through multiple pathways, not solely through value overestimation (C6, D040)

### 5. Discussion
- Mechanism: why trained dt_embedding causes CIVO (RSSM fidelity gap at dt>1)
- RSSM fidelity analysis: 008d reward gap (2.78x) vs 008f reward gap (1.01x)
- **D040: Multiple vulnerability pathways**: Pathway A (CIVO, value-driven) + Pathway B (non-CIVO policy instability, eval-driven)
- **D107: Gradient-level interventions fail entirely**: SGS 0/3 (full) + 1/6 (obs-decoder) + 0/2 (reward-only) = backward-pass is categorically insufficient. Gradient magnitude ≠ causal importance (reward 38-49% but reward-only SGS fails worst; obs-decoder 16-22% but targeted SGS also fails). Forward-pass representational damage is the irreducible floor.
- **Compensatory amplification**: Blocking obs-decoder on Cheetah → 2.6-3.6× NVE amplification vs untreated. Blocking reward → obs-decoder reliance increases → spatial bias reinforced.
- **Universal value collapse**: Obs-decoder SGS degrades all seeds' critic calibration (ve_ratio 0.056-0.14 @215K), including CIVO-free seeds. "Protection" = trading overestimation for underestimation.
- **Fourth CIVO trajectory (s3)**: Latent onset → delayed collapse → policy recovery → persistent value collapse. CIVO-induced critic damage may be irreversible.
- MPC vs imagination: TAWM succeeds because MPC re-plans from real states; imagination-based critic bootstrapping creates the positive feedback loop
- **D032: Value self-correction mechanism (009b)**: Transient vs sustained nve>1.5x determines outcome. Early stochasticity (initialization, data sampling) is the gate.

### 6. Implications for Future Work
- **D113: Intervention Hierarchy — all three levels fail or partially fail**: Gradient (SGS 1/17), Output (RAVE 0/2), Representation (TCN 2/8 with high variance). dt_embedding removal 5/5 but removes the feature entirely.
- TCN existence proof (Walker σ=0.2) shows mitigation is *possible in principle* but fragile — narrow dose window, environment-dependent, high seed variance in eval retention
- **Dose-environment dependency**: No universal σ exists; Walker-effective dose (σ=0.2) underdoses Cheetah/PickCube, Walker-overdose (σ=0.5) still underdoses Cheetah
- RSSM prediction quality must improve before variable-rate imagination is viable
- Hierarchical temporal abstraction (THICK, Hieros) may avoid flat-conditioning failure by maintaining separate dynamics per temporal scale
- Need for diagnostic methodology in temporal abstraction research

## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns

### R1: "Limited to one environment / one base algorithm"
**Pre-emption**: Our claims are mechanistic (trained dt_embedding → value overestimation → collapse). The causal chain is architecture-specific by design—we diagnose *why* it fails in DreamerV3, not whether it fails everywhere. The mechanism (RSSM fidelity gap) likely generalizes to other latent-dynamics models but we scope claims conservatively.
**Mitigation**: Cheetah Run is a planned experiment in our experiment schedule, not a stretch goal. We will include at least one additional DMC environment (Cheetah Run) to demonstrate generality of the mechanism.

### R2: "No proposed solution — what's the actionable takeaway?"
**Pre-emption**: Our primary contribution is diagnostic, not prescriptive. Beyond diagnosis, we provide a **systematic Intervention Hierarchy** evaluating 7+ methods across 3 levels (gradient/output/representation) and 3 environments. This is the most comprehensive evaluation of CIVO interventions to date. The key finding: even the most promising intervention (TCN, representation-level) succeeds only under narrow conditions (Walker σ=0.2, 2/8 configs, 45-91% eval retention). The actionable takeaway is that CIVO requires fundamental architectural solutions (hierarchical temporal abstraction per THICK/Hieros), not post-hoc interventions.
**Mitigation**: The Intervention Hierarchy table (7 methods × 3 levels) is a standalone contribution — it saves future researchers from re-exploring these dead ends and provides a systematic framework for evaluating future interventions.

### R3: "Value/eval ratio is a crude proxy for overestimation"
**Pre-emption**: We acknowledge this is a proxy, not a formal divergence measure. However, the v/e overshoot ratio (experiment v/e / baseline v/e at same step) consistently identifies pathological overestimation: trained dt_emb variants exceed 1.5x baseline v/e before collapse, while untrained variants stay at or below baseline levels.
**Mitigation**: Add distributional analysis of value predictions vs. realized returns if time permits.

### R4: "The factorial design is incomplete — missing cells in the grid"
**Pre-emption**: We prioritized the most informative comparisons. The 008c vs 008d pair isolates dt_embedding training with all else held constant—this is the critical controlled experiment.
**Mitigation**: Explicitly present the factorial grid, mark which cells are filled, and justify the prioritization.

### R5: "Novelty concern — model exploitation / value overestimation in MBRL is well-known"
**Pre-emption**: General MBRL overestimation is known (Janner et al., 2019), but three elements are genuinely novel: (a) **MPC vs imagination architectural boundary** — first empirical evidence that dt-conditioning succeeds in MPC (TAWM) but fails in imagination-based AC, localizing vulnerability to critic bootstrapping architecture; (b) **gradient magnitude ≠ causal importance** — reward head carries 38-49% of gradients but is causally irrelevant, obs-decoder carries 16-22% but is causally critical (broader methodological insight for multi-head MBRL debugging); (c) **systematic three-level intervention hierarchy** — not a single failure report but a complete taxonomy of 7 methods × 3 levels with structured negative evidence.
**Mitigation**: Expand Related Work to engage deeply with MBPO framework, explicitly articulate what CIVO reveals that MBPO does not predict (the specific *trigger* through temporal conditioning, the MPC/imagination divergence, the gradient-causality dissociation).

### R6: "All results from a single seed — how robust are the conclusions?"
**Pre-emption (D032 update)**: Multi-seed data now available. The nve>1.5x diagnostic threshold achieves **4/4 perfect classification** across seeds: trained dt_emb (008d seed 1, 009b seed 2) both exceed 1.5x; untrained (008f seed 1, 009c seed 2) neither exceeds 1.5x. Collapse itself is stochastic (1/2 trained seeds), which we report transparently — our claim is about the reliable **diagnostic marker** (nve>1.5x), not deterministic collapse.
**[D040]** C6 partially falsified: 008e_v3_s2 collapsed via non-CIVO pathway (eval-driven, entropy ↑). 009a baseline s2 stable (618→596→836) — rules out seed fragility. Trained dt_embedding creates multiple vulnerability pathways: CIVO (Pathway A, 008d) and policy instability (Pathway B, 008e_v3_s2). dt=1 imagination eliminates Pathway A but not B.
**Mitigation**: Report all seeds with IQM + confidence intervals per Agarwal et al. (2021). The 4/4 separation is robust. Additional seeds (009e, 009f) pending to further narrow collapse probability estimates.

### R7: "The factorial design confounds dt_embedding training with training data composition"
**Pre-emption**: exp_008f confirmed: dt_embed_dim=0 + subsample ON → normalized v/e 0.83x@45K (healthy), vs 008d@45K=2.09x (collapse at v/e=69.3%). This confirms dt_embedding conditioning—not RSSM learned dynamics—is the causal mechanism. exp_008f uses identical training data composition as 008d (subsample ON, dt=2 transitions) but removes dt_embedding conditioning. Through 55K, 008f remained in normal range (normalized v/e 0.73-1.02x).
**Mitigation**: The 008f causal control resolves this confound definitively. The three-way comparison (008c: subsample OFF/untrained, 008d: subsample ON/trained, 008f: subsample ON/no dt_embed) isolates dt_embedding conditioning as the necessary and sufficient factor for CIVO.

### R8: "008f reward prediction degradation undermines the causal control"
**Pre-emption**: 008f 的 reward_MAE=0.747（baseline 75x）是重要发现，但不削弱 C2 因果结论。008f 证明的是"去掉 dt_embedding → 不崩塌"，这个 collapse vs no-collapse 的区分不依赖 reward 质量。008f 的低 v/e 部分源于奖励噪声，但关键对比是 008d 的 v/e 加速发散 vs 008f 的 v/e 保持稳定——模式差异才是因果证据。
**Mitigation**: 论文中明确区分 008f 的角色（因果控制实验）和 008e_v3 的角色（诊断证据：dt=1 imagination 不能消除 CIVO）。RSSM fidelity 表同时报告绝对误差和比率，避免审稿人被 008d 的低 obs gap ratio（1.30x，但绝对误差 41.31 已是 baseline 3x）误导。

### R9: "Why not test standard overestimation countermeasures (Double Q, ensemble critics)?" [Dream D1 — 三档一致 #1 弱点] → **已实验回答 (D118-D123)**

**实验结果（D118-D124 dual-critic + mechanism ablation 系列）**：

**1. Dual-critic 跨环境结果（D128 更新）**：
- Walker wide dual-critic: **3/3 CIVO prevented**（s0 eval 739.7, s1 551.8, s2 ~121）。NVE 全程 < 1.5
  - ⚠️ **s2 非 CIVO 崩溃**：NVE 正常但 eval 354→121，actor entropy 急升(-3.59→-0.45)。可能是 policy exploration failure。**必须区分 "CIVO prevention"(3/3) vs "performance stability"(2/3)**
- Walker narrow dual-critic: 1/1 CIVO occurred (NVE 2.75) → full recovery eval 697.8
- Cheetah dual-critic: CIVO 发生(NVE 1.75) → 部分恢复 eval 97.5 (31%, 晚期下降)
- Cheetah wide single: CIVO 发生(NVE 3.59) → 自修复 eval 146 (晚期下降)。Wide > dual in Cheetah (146 vs 97.5)
- PickCube dual-critic: NVE 短暂升至 2.3 后自行修正，**PickCube 不触发持续性 CIVO**（任务动态不同）。eval 27.7 的低性能源于 gate 配置本身对 manipulation 任务有害（vanilla baseline 58.6 → 加 subsample+dt_emb 后 26.6），非 CIVO 导致。PickCube 作为 scope limitation 讨论，跨环境 CIVO 叙事聚焦 locomotion (Walker/Cheetah)
- **v1≈v2 across all environments and all configs**（ρ>0.999 Walker; exact match Cheetah/PickCube）

**2. v1≈v2 核心发现**：Double Q 的 pessimism 机制在 pure-imagination MBRL 中失效。两个 critic 共享相同 world model imagined features → 收敛到相同函数。Per-sample pessimism 仅为独立 critic 理论值的 3-4%（ρ>0.998）。

**3. 2×2 Mechanism Factorial（D126 — 全部 4 格填满）**：
| | Single critic | Dual critic (min) |
|--|--------------|-------------------|
| ~1.05-1.2M params | baseline (**CIVO → 永久崩溃**) | **exp_035 narrow: CIVO(NVE 2.75) → 恢复中 → eval 149+** |
| ~2.4-2.9M params | **exp_033 wide: CIVO(NVE 4.75) → 自修复 → eval 408** | **exp_032: CIVO 预防(NVE≤1.1) → eval 670-788** |

**4. 双维度发现（D127 最终修正 — 论文最核心新发现）**：

**Recovery 维度（min 是主导因素）**：
| 配置 | CIVO 发生? | NVE peak | eval final | 恢复能力 |
|------|-----------|----------|------------|---------|
| Baseline (single+normal) | ✓ | ~2-4 | collapsed | 无 |
| exp_033 (single+wide) | ✓ | 4.75 | 408 | 部分(capacity) |
| **exp_035 (dual+narrow)** | **✓** | **2.75** | **697.8** | **完全(min)** |
| exp_032 (dual+wide) | ✗ | ≤1.1 | 670-788 | 无需恢复 |

- **Min 的核心价值是 recovery 而非 prevention**：exp_035 eval 697.8 ≈ exp_032 670-788，尽管经历了 CIVO
- **Min >> Capacity for recovery**：697.8 vs 408。min 实现完全恢复，capacity 仅部分恢复
- **Min 同时降低 CIVO 严重度**：exp_035 NVE 2.75 < exp_033 NVE 4.75

**Prevention 维度（需 min+capacity 协同）**：
- 只有 exp_032 (min+capacity) 从未触发 CIVO（NVE≤1.1）
- Prevention 优势不是最终性能（≈recovery-with-min），而是**训练效率**（节省 ~40K steps 恢复期）
- v1≈v2 在所有 dual-critic 中成立（包括 exp_032）→ 协同效应是经验事实，机制为 hypothesis

**跨环境 caveat**：Walker 上 recovery 充分(697.8)，但 Cheetah 上 recovery 不充分(97.5, 31%)。环境越难，recovery 越不可靠 → prevention 在难环境中价值更大。

**⚠️ 机制为 open hypothesis**：v1≈v2 在所有 dual-critic 中成立。可能的解释：(a) min 在训练早期(v1≠v2 时)建立了稳定学习轨迹 (b) min-target coupling 在 wider network 的 smoother loss landscape 上更有效 (c) capacity 提升 value calibration 质量而非多样性。论文中诚实报告经验事实，机制标注为 hypothesis。

**论文 narrative（D127 最终版）**：双维度报告——(a) Prevention: min+capacity 协同预防 CIVO（训练效率优势）(b) Recovery: min 是 CIVO 后恢复的主导因素（被低估的特性）(c) 跨环境：难环境中 recovery 不充分，凸显 prevention 的必要性 (d) v1≈v2: pessimism 机制失效但 min 通过其他通路起效（open question）

**5. 环境依赖性（D125 — exp_034 完成）**：
- **Walker（中等 CIVO，untreated NVE 2-4）**：min 操作完全预防 CIVO（2/2 seeds）
- **Cheetah（高强度 CIVO，untreated NVE 8.27-70.64，seed 间高方差）**：min 操作将 NVE peak 从 baseline 8.27-70.64 降至 1.75（≥4× reduction），但仍超 1.5 阈值，不能完全预防。双倍参数(2.36M)实现部分恢复(eval 97.5)但仅达 pre-CIVO 峰值的 31% 且晚期下降。对比 Walker wide-critic(exp_033) 恢复到 408(>pre-CIVO)，说明**环境动力学复杂度是恢复质量的决定性因素**。（来源：exp_010b s0 NVE_final=70.64, s1 NVE_peak=8.27。论文中须报告两个 seed 并使用保守 claim "≥4× NVE reduction"，不用 40×）
- **论文 claim 限定**："min=prevention" 必须加 "in moderate-CIVO environments" 限定，否则审稿人拿 Cheetah 数据直接攻击。这反而强化 intervention hierarchy 叙事——即使 architecture-level 干预也有 CIVO 严重度边界

**论文 narrative（D126 修正）**：从"为什么不测标准对策"转为"我们测了——(a) pessimism 机制失效（v1≈v2 across all configs），(b) min alone 和 capacity alone 都不能预防 CIVO，(c) 两者协同（min+capacity）才能预防，(d) 机制：capacity 提供函数多样性 + min 约束 overestimation 反馈环，(e) prevention >> recovery"。2×2 factorial 的**交互效应**比任何单因素更有方法论启示——对 ML 社区的 critic 设计指导价值更高。

### R10: "NVE threshold is calibrated and validated in-sample" [Dream D8 — 三档一致]
**Pre-emption**: 承认 1.5× threshold 在同一 29 个数据点上 calibrate 和 validate。但 (a) Youden-optimal threshold (1.53×) 独立收敛到预设 1.5×，不是事后拟合；(b) 4 环境 × 多种 configs 提供 reasonable diversity；(c) ground truth labeling 基于 mechanism identification（CIVO vs non-CIVO dynamics），不是简单的 performance threshold。
**Mitigation**: 明确承认 limitation，建议 held-out validation（不同架构或环境）作为 future work。讨论 NVE 在不同 reward scale 下的 generalization boundary。

### R11: "Pixel observations would change the gradient decomposition" [Dream D9 — 三档一致]
**Pre-emption**: 正确——pixel 下 obs-decoder channel（本文识别为 16-22% 梯度但因果关键）会承载更多信息和更大梯度。CIVO 动态可能更强（更多空间信息可利用）或更弱（decoder 正则化效应更强）。这是一个重要的泛化性边界。
**Mitigation**: 在 limitations 中明确讨论，定位为 future work。强调本文在 proprioceptive setting 的发现建立了 CIVO 的基础机制理论，pixel 扩展需要后续工作。

| exp_026_obs_sgs_cheetah (s0+s1) | 阻断 obs-decoder→dt_emb 梯度消除 Cheetah CIVO | **补偿放大**：阻断 obs-decoder 后 NVE 从 untreated 8.3× 恶化到 21.9-30.2×（2.6-3.6× 放大）。阻断一条通路导致剩余通路 co-adaptation 加剧 | 高 | Section 3/Discussion 作为 "compensatory amplification" 现象。对 multi-head architecture 干预设计有普适警示：局部干预可能比不干预更糟 |

## Coherent Story: Intervention Hierarchy 与多层失败叙事

### 核心 Narrative

35 个 negative 实验组合构成了一个 **escalating intervention failure** 的完整叙事，从最轻量（gradient manipulation）到最重量（architecture redesign），系统性证明 CIVO 在所有干预层级上的抗性：

```
干预层级           方法               成功率      关键失败机制
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
L1 Gradient        Reward SGS         0/2        No-op (梯度≠因果)
                   Full SGS           0/3        Forward-pass damage 不可逆
                   Obs-decoder SGS    1/6        补偿放大 + critic 校准损坏
L2 Output          RAVE               0/2        EMA anchor 自身被污染
L3 Representation  TCN                2/8        Dose-env dependency, 无 Goldilocks zone
L4 Architecture    Dual-critic        3/5*       v1≈v2 (pessimism 失效),
                                                 non-CIVO collapse (Pathway B)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Control            dt_emb removal     5/5        不是干预——移除了 feature
```

*Walker 2/3 CIVO prevented + 1 non-CIVO collapse; Cheetah 0/1; PickCube 功能性失败

### 这个 Hierarchy 为什么构成 Positive Contribution

1. **节约社区资源**：7+ 方法 × 3 层级 × 3 环境的系统性 negative evidence，阻止后续研究者重复探索这些 dead ends
2. **揭示 CIVO 的本质**：不是 gradient 问题（SGS 失败）、不是 value magnitude 问题（RAVE 失败）、不是 critic independence 问题（v1≈v2），而是 **forward-pass representational entanglement**
3. **方法论启示**：
   - "梯度量级 ≠ 因果重要性" 对所有 multi-head MBRL 系统的 debugging 有普适价值
   - "补偿放大" 对 partial intervention 设计的警示
   - "impossible dose" 证明某些 failure mode 不能通过 tuning 解决

### 三条辅助 Narrative

**A. Multi-Pathway Vulnerability（多路径脆弱性）**
- exp_008e_v3_s2 + exp_038 共同证明：trained dt_emb 通过至少两条路径创造脆弱性
  - Pathway A (CIVO): value overestimation → actor exploitation → entropy ↓ → collapse
  - Pathway B (IRD): eval-driven destabilization → entropy ↑ → policy randomization
- dt=1 imagination 消除 Pathway A 但不消除 B
- Dual-critic 消除 CIVO 但不消除 non-CIVO collapse
- **论文价值**: 即使"解决" CIVO，trained dt_emb 仍不安全

**B. Environment Severity Boundary（环境严重度边界）**
- Walker（NVE 1.5-5×）: TCN 2/4, dual-critic 2/3 有效
- Cheetah（NVE 8-70×）: TCN 0/3, dual-critic 0/1, σ=1.0 impossible dose
- PickCube: 任务动态本质不同，gate 配置本身有害
- **论文价值**: 所有干预方法都有 CIVO severity ceiling，强化 "根本解决需要架构革新" 的结论

**C. Origin Story（研究方向转向）**
- exp_003→004→005 (event-gate v2-v4) 的连续失败催生了 CIVO 研究方向
- 从 "如何让 temporal abstraction work" 到 "为什么 temporal abstraction fails"
- **论文价值**: Introduction 叙事起点，展示研究动机的自然性

---

## 论文各 Section 对应的 Negative Results 使用建议

| Section | 使用的 Negative Results | 功能 |
|---------|------------------------|------|
| Introduction | exp_003-005 (event-gate 失败) | 研究动机：试图做 temporal abstraction 但反复失败，转向诊断 why |
| Section 3.1-3.2 (CIVO 诊断) | exp_009e/009b (CIVO 复现) | 作为 multi-seed 数据点确认 CIVO 可复现性和随机性 |
| Section 3.3 (Gradient analysis) | exp_016e (reward SGS no-op) | "梯度 ≠ 因果" 核心发现 |
| Section 3.4 (SGS 系列) | exp_018v2/018_s2/021/025/026 | Intervention Hierarchy L1 全面否定；补偿放大 |
| Section 3.5 (RAVE) | exp_028/028_ceil15 | L2 否定；anchor 污染机制 |
| Section 3.6 (TCN) | exp_027-031b 全系列 | L3 部分否定；impossible dose；dose-env dependency |
| Section 3.7 (Dual-critic) | exp_034/036/037/038 | L4 部分否定；v1≈v2；non-CIVO collapse |
| Section 4 (C6 multi-pathway) | exp_008e_v3_s2/s3 + exp_038 | 多路径脆弱性证据 |
| Discussion (dt>1 limitation) | exp_006/007/008c/008f_s4 | 即使解决 CIVO，dt>1 仍有 40-70% 性能损失 |
| Discussion (scope) | exp_051 (StackCube frozen 失败) + exp_036 (PickCube) | Locomotion-specific scope boundary |
| Discussion (frozen dt_emb) | exp_015b | 不能冻结触发参数——architecturally entangled |

---

## 总结

35 个 negative 实验中：
- **7 个高 insight**：构成 Intervention Hierarchy + Multi-Pathway Vulnerability 两大核心贡献
- **10 个中 insight**：提供边界条件、scope limitation、design constraint
- **10+ 个低 insight**：作为统计数据点计入，不需独立讨论

最重要的 framing 策略：这些 negative results **不是 limitation**，而是论文的 **primary contribution**。一篇 diagnostic paper 的价值恰恰在于系统性地证明某个问题有多难解决，以及为什么难。Intervention Hierarchy（7 methods × 3 levels × 3 environments）是同类工作中最全面的 CIVO 干预评估，其 negative nature 本身就是强贡献。

| exp_025_obs_sgs_walker_s2 | Obs-decoder-only SGS 抑制 CIVO | CIVO 部分抑制但 eval 仅 7-10% baseline。obs-decoder SGS 摧毁性能 | 低 | 被 C7 的 1/6 统计和 universal value collapse 发现吸收 |
| exp_029c (σ=0.1) | σ=0.1 是最低有效剂量 | NVE breach 但最终 eval 尚可（328）。剂量不足 | 低 | dose-response 曲线的一个数据点 |
| exp_027_tcn_walker_s0 (σ=0.5) | TCN σ=0.5 抑制 CIVO | NVE peak 4.0, oscillatory CIVO。σ=0.5 在 Walker 过量 | 低 | dose-response 的 overdose 端参考 |
| exp_027_tcn_walker_s1 (σ=0.5 s1) | TCN σ=0.5 seed 1 复现 | NVE 1.64, oscillatory。与 s0 一致：σ=0.5 过量 | 低 | 同上 |

---

## Coherent Story: Intervention Hierarchy 与多层失败叙事

### 核心 Narrative

35 个 negative 实验组合构成了一个 **escalating intervention failure** 的完整叙事，从最轻量（gradient manipulation）到最重量（architecture redesign），系统性证明 CIVO 在所有干预层级上的抗性：

```
干预层级           方法               成功率      关键失败机制
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
L1 Gradient        Reward SGS         0/2        No-op (梯度≠因果)
                   Full SGS           0/3        Forward-pass damage 不可逆
                   Obs-decoder SGS    1/6        补偿放大 + critic 校准损坏
L2 Output          RAVE               0/2        EMA anchor 自身被污染
L3 Representation  TCN                2/8        Dose-env dependency, 无 Goldilocks zone
L4 Architecture    Dual-critic        3/5*       v1≈v2 (pessimism 失效),
                                                 non-CIVO collapse (Pathway B)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Control            dt_emb removal     5/5        不是干预——移除了 feature
```

*Walker 2/3 CIVO prevented + 1 non-CIVO collapse; Cheetah 0/1; PickCube 功能性失败

### 这个 Hierarchy 为什么构成 Positive Contribution

1. **节约社区资源**：7+ 方法 × 3 层级 × 3 环境的系统性 negative evidence，阻止后续研究者重复探索这些 dead ends
2. **揭示 CIVO 的本质**：不是 gradient 问题（SGS 失败）、不是 value magnitude 问题（RAVE 失败）、不是 critic independence 问题（v1≈v2），而是 **forward-pass representational entanglement**
3. **方法论启示**：
   - "梯度量级 ≠ 因果重要性" 对所有 multi-head MBRL 系统的 debugging 有普适价值
   - "补偿放大" 对 partial intervention 设计的警示
   - "impossible dose" 证明某些 failure mode 不能通过 tuning 解决

### 三条辅助 Narrative

**A. Multi-Pathway Vulnerability（多路径脆弱性）**
- exp_008e_v3_s2 + exp_038 共同证明：trained dt_emb 通过至少两条路径创造脆弱性
  - Pathway A (CIVO): value overestimation → actor exploitation → entropy ↓ → collapse
  - Pathway B (IRD): eval-driven destabilization → entropy ↑ → policy randomization
- dt=1 imagination 消除 Pathway A 但不消除 B
- Dual-critic 消除 CIVO 但不消除 non-CIVO collapse
- **论文价值**: 即使"解决" CIVO，trained dt_emb 仍不安全

**B. Environment Severity Boundary（环境严重度边界）**
- Walker（NVE 1.5-5×）: TCN 2/4, dual-critic 2/3 有效
- Cheetah（NVE 8-70×）: TCN 0/3, dual-critic 0/1, σ=1.0 impossible dose
- PickCube: 任务动态本质不同，gate 配置本身有害
- **论文价值**: 所有干预方法都有 CIVO severity ceiling，强化 "根本解决需要架构革新" 的结论

**C. Origin Story（研究方向转向）**
- exp_003→004→005 (event-gate v2-v4) 的连续失败催生了 CIVO 研究方向
- 从 "如何让 temporal abstraction work" 到 "为什么 temporal abstraction fails"
- **论文价值**: Introduction 叙事起点，展示研究动机的自然性

---

## 论文各 Section 对应的 Negative Results 使用建议

| Section | 使用的 Negative Results | 功能 |
|---------|------------------------|------|
| Introduction | exp_003-005 (event-gate 失败) | 研究动机：试图做 temporal abstraction 但反复失败，转向诊断 why |
| Section 3.1-3.2 (CIVO 诊断) | exp_009e/009b (CIVO 复现) | 作为 multi-seed 数据点确认 CIVO 可复现性和随机性 |
| Section 3.3 (Gradient analysis) | exp_016e (reward SGS no-op) | "梯度 ≠ 因果" 核心发现 |
| Section 3.4 (SGS 系列) | exp_018v2/018_s2/021/025/026 | Intervention Hierarchy L1 全面否定；补偿放大 |
| Section 3.5 (RAVE) | exp_028/028_ceil15 | L2 否定；anchor 污染机制 |
| Section 3.6 (TCN) | exp_027-031b 全系列 | L3 部分否定；impossible dose；dose-env dependency |
| Section 3.7 (Dual-critic) | exp_034/036/037/038 | L4 部分否定；v1≈v2；non-CIVO collapse |
| Section 4 (C6 multi-pathway) | exp_008e_v3_s2/s3 + exp_038 | 多路径脆弱性证据 |
| Discussion (dt>1 limitation) | exp_006/007/008c/008f_s4 | 即使解决 CIVO，dt>1 仍有 40-70% 性能损失 |
| Discussion (scope) | exp_051 (StackCube frozen 失败) + exp_036 (PickCube) | Locomotion-specific scope boundary |
| Discussion (frozen dt_emb) | exp_015b | 不能冻结触发参数——architecturally entangled |

---

## 总结

35 个 negative 实验中：
- **7 个高 insight**：构成 Intervention Hierarchy + Multi-Pathway Vulnerability 两大核心贡献
- **10 个中 insight**：提供边界条件、scope limitation、design constraint
- **10+ 个低 insight**：作为统计数据点计入，不需独立讨论

最重要的 framing 策略：这些 negative results **不是 limitation**，而是论文的 **primary contribution**。一篇 diagnostic paper 的价值恰恰在于系统性地证明某个问题有多难解决，以及为什么难。Intervention Hierarchy（7 methods × 3 levels × 3 environments）是同类工作中最全面的 CIVO 干预评估，其 negative nature 本身就是强贡献。

**7 个高 insight negative results** 构成论文两大 positive contribution：

2. **Multi-Pathway Vulnerability**（exp_008e_v3_s2 + exp_038）— trained dt_emb 通过至少两条路径创造脆弱性（CIVO = value-driven + IRD = eval-driven），消除一条不能保障安全

- **exp_016e**: 梯度量级 ≠ 因果重要性（reward head 49% 梯度但因果无关）

- **exp_026**: 补偿放大（阻断一条通路导致 2.6-3.6× 恶化）

这些 negative results 不是 limitation，而是 diagnostic paper 的 primary contribution——系统性证明问题有多难解决。
